selection_scope: previously_used_training_only; folds summarize robustness, not blind generalization
interpretation: Fixed scalar guidance budget, not calibration or accuracy guarantee. RMS uses local quadratic energy; KL uses actual full-vocabulary forward KL per target position with 16 FP32 bisections and feasible lower endpoint. No fitting or coefficient scan.
cost: All base recipes need logical K4 and head readouts K1/K4. Optional external score-late compositions need K5. KL recipe performs cap check, 16 bisection KL evaluations, final feasibility recheck and target LL normalization; not zero-cost.
